items.source: Return whether the given BeanDefinition matches the lookup configuration.
items.translation: 判断给定的BeanDefinition是否与查找配置匹配。

items.source: Returns the bean name of the implementation to be looked up.
items.translation: 返回要查找的实现类的 Bean 名称。

items.source: Returns the simple name of the class to be looked up.
items.translation: 返回要查找的类的简单名称。

items.source: Returns whether the bean name created for the given bean definition results in the one required. Will be used to disambiguate between multiple BeanDefinitions matching in general.
items.translation: 返回为给定 Bean 定义创建的 Bean 名称是否匹配所需名称。此方法将用于在多个通用的BeanDefinition之间进行区分。

items.source: Configuration that's used to lookup an implementation type for a repository or fragment interface.
items.translation: 用于查找存储库或片段接口实现类型的配置。

items.source: Returns whether the bean name created for the given bean definition results in the one required.
items.translation: 判断为给定 Bean 定义创建的 Bean 名称是否满足要求。
